title: Palace of King Bell
geometryBasis: The native named outline determines ground orientation and projections. The south approach aligns with the public approach loop and the main front stairs.
sectionBasis: The public-domain 1907 photograph gives the arched verandas, layered shallow roofs, wide stairs and top pavilion. A preservation account confirms the standing historic structure.
limitations: Paint colors and less visible rear elevations are generalized from available evidence. Small fretwork and columns reproduce the visible pattern at a practical model scale.
The coarse elevation data include surface returns and do not survey the individual stair treads or wall footings.
